title: MATLAB code for "Mathematical Modeling of AA Amyloidosis: Coupling SAA–HDL Binding Dynamics with Path-Dependent Renal Aging"

creators.name: Kuznetsov, Andrey V.
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, North Carolina State University, Raleigh, NC 27695-7910, USA

description:
MATLAB implementation of the model of AA amyloidosis that couples saturable SAA–HDL binding to renal filtration of free SAA, lysosomal cleavage to AA fragments, Finke–Watzky aggregation, oligomer deposition and fibril turnover, and converts the accumulated damage into a renal biological age.

Contents: 22 scripts that reproduce every figure of the main text and supplementary material and Table 3 (dimensionless sensitivity coefficients), eight supporting routines (model right-hand sides, Table 2 parameters, the time-varying solver, the closed-form steady state, damage measures, the flare profile and a figure-export helper), and a README that lists, for every figure, the script that reproduces it.

Base MATLAB only; no toolboxes required. Tested on R2023a.
